blocks.zh: 清潔度與污染控制（續）— Line Clearance, Regrind, Pallet Controls
blocks.en: Cleanliness and Contamination Control (continued): Line Clearance, Regrind, Pallet Controls

blocks.zh: 教育解說 / Commentary
blocks.en: Commentary

blocks.zh: Line Clearance 是什麼？為什麼重要？
blocks.en: What Is Line Clearance and Why Does It Matter?

blocks.zh: 換線清場（Line Clearance）是指在一個批次生產結束、下一個批次開始之前，對生產線進行全面確認，確保前一批次的任何材料、標籤、文件都已完全清除。
blocks.en: Line clearance is the comprehensive check of the production line carried out after one batch ends and before the next begins, to ensure that all materials, labels and documents from the previous batch have been completely removed.

blocks.zh: 在包材廠，這包含：確認所有模具/工具已清除；確認標籤已移除；確認前批材料無殘留；完成清場記錄並由 QC 確認。
blocks.en: In a packaging plant this includes: confirming that all molds/tools have been removed; confirming that labels have been removed; confirming that no material from the previous batch remains; and completing the clearance record, which is verified by QC.

blocks.zh: 比喻：餐廳換桌
blocks.en: Analogy: Turning Over a Restaurant Table

blocks.zh: 換線清場就像餐廳服務生在客人離開後必須重新整理桌子——確認前一桌的碗碟、餐具、剩食全部清除，才能讓下一桌入座。若只做一半（半清場），就必須有明確規則保證「不會把前一桌的東西遺留給下一桌」。
blocks.en: Line clearance is like a waiter resetting a table after guests leave: the plates, cutlery and leftovers from the previous party must all be cleared before the next party is seated. If only a partial clearance is done, there must be clear rules that guarantee nothing from the previous table is left for the next one.

blocks.zh: 在製藥包材中，「前批次殘留」可能導致藥品被錯誤包裝、標籤混淆，是嚴重的 GMP 違規。
blocks.en: In pharmaceutical primary packaging, "carry-over from the previous batch" can lead to medicinal products being packed in the wrong material or to labeling mix-ups, which is a serious GMP violation.

blocks.zh: GMP 重點：自動換線不能免除風險評估
blocks.en: GMP Key Point: Automatic Changeover Does Not Remove the Need for Risk Assessment

blocks.zh: 某些現代生產線採用自動化換線系統，號稱可縮短換線時間且不需全清場——但 ISO 15378 明確要求這類系統仍需經過書面風險評估，並建立控制措施。「自動化」不等於「不需驗證」。
blocks.en: Some modern production lines use automated changeover systems that are claimed to shorten changeover time and avoid a full line clearance. However, ISO 15378 explicitly requires that such systems still undergo a documented risk assessment and that control measures be established. "Automated" does not mean "no validation needed".

blocks.zh: 木棧板的隱藏風險
blocks.en: The Hidden Risk of Wooden Pallets

blocks.zh: 8.5.1.3.14 特別提醒木棧板的污染風險：木材可能吸附化學品（例如防蟲劑、防腐劑），並在儲存或運輸過程中遷移至包材表面。許多高規格包材廠已改用塑膠棧板，或對木棧板實施嚴格的來源管控與檢驗。
blocks.en: Clause 8.5.1.3.14 specifically warns about contamination from wooden pallets: wood can absorb chemicals (for example insecticides and preservatives) that may then migrate onto the surface of packaging materials during storage or transport. Many high-specification packaging plants have switched to plastic pallets or apply strict source control and inspection to wooden pallets.

blocks.zh: 為什麼藥品包材廠要承擔比一般包裝廠更高的 GMP 要求
blocks.en: Why Primary Packaging Manufacturers Carry a Higher GMP Burden than General Packaging Plants

blocks.zh: ISO 15378 的雙層架構邏輯
blocks.en: The Logic of the Two-Layer Structure of ISO 15378

blocks.zh: ISO 15378 刻意採用「ISO 9001 基礎條文 + GMP 附加要求」的結構，原因在於：
blocks.en: ISO 15378 deliberately uses a structure of "ISO 9001 base clauses + additional GMP requirements", for these reasons:

blocks.zh: 讓已持有 ISO 9001 認證的製造商能清楚看到「升級差距」
blocks.en: Manufacturers already certified to ISO 9001 can clearly see the "upgrade gap"

blocks.zh: 方便稽核員比對 ISO 9001 基礎合規 vs. 藥品特定要求
blocks.en: It lets auditors compare ISO 9001 baseline compliance with the medicinal-product-specific requirements

blocks.zh: 使標準可隨 ISO 9001 改版同步更新（2017 版即對應 ISO 9001:2015）
blocks.en: It allows the standard to be updated in step with revisions of ISO 9001 (the 2017 edition corresponds to ISO 9001:2015)

blocks.zh: 實務上，一般包裝廠只需符合 ISO 9001；而藥品包材廠則必須同時滿足 ISO 9001 基礎條文 加上 所有附加 GMP 要求。
blocks.en: In practice, a general packaging plant only needs to comply with ISO 9001, whereas a pharmaceutical primary packaging manufacturer must meet the ISO 9001 base clauses plus all of the additional GMP requirements.

blocks.zh: 比喻：一般廚師 vs. 手術室備餐人員
blocks.en: Analogy: An Ordinary Cook vs. an Operating-Theatre Caterer

blocks.zh: 一般包裝廠就像普通餐廳廚師——遵守食品衛生法規即可。但藥品包材廠更像為手術室備餐的人員——除了食品衛生，還必須符合無菌操作規範、穿著潔淨服、在受控環境中工作。
blocks.en: A general packaging plant is like an ordinary restaurant cook, who only has to follow food hygiene regulations. A pharmaceutical primary packaging manufacturer is more like someone preparing meals for an operating theatre: in addition to food hygiene, they must follow aseptic practice, wear cleanroom garments and work in a controlled environment.

blocks.zh: 產品的最終用途（接觸患者的藥品）決定了製造環境必須達到的標準。
blocks.en: The end use of the product (a medicinal product that contacts the patient) determines the standard the manufacturing environment must reach.

blocks.zh: 無菌一次包材的特殊要求 — 滅菌驗證、記錄與外包管控
blocks.en: Special Requirements for Sterile Primary Packaging: Sterilization Validation, Records and Outsourcing Control

blocks.zh: 哪些包材需要滅菌？
blocks.en: Which Packaging Materials Need to Be Sterilized?

blocks.zh: 需要滅菌的一次包材主要包括：用於無菌注射劑的橡膠塞（Rubber Stoppers）、用於無菌粉末的管制玻璃瓶（Vials）組件、預充填注射器（Pre-filled Syringes）用注射器筒、以及某些醫療級袋子（IV Bags）等。
blocks.en: Primary packaging materials that require sterilization mainly include: rubber stoppers for sterile injectables; vial components for sterile powders; syringe barrels for pre-filled syringes; and certain medical-grade bags (IV bags).

blocks.zh: 關鍵點：這些包材在出廠後會直接接觸無菌藥品，所以包材廠自身也必須確保包材達到規定的無菌保障水準（SAL, Sterility Assurance Level）。
blocks.en: Key point: these materials contact the sterile medicinal product directly after leaving the plant, so the packaging manufacturer itself must also ensure that they achieve the specified sterility assurance level (SAL).

blocks.zh: 滅菌驗證的三大參考標準
blocks.en: Three Key Reference Standards for Sterilization Validation

blocks.zh: ISO 11135：環氧乙烷（EO）滅菌的驗證與常規控制
blocks.en: ISO 11135: validation and routine control of ethylene oxide (EO) sterilization

blocks.zh: ISO 11137-1/-2：放射線滅菌（Gamma、E-beam）的驗證要求
blocks.en: ISO 11137-1/-2: validation requirements for radiation sterilization (gamma, e-beam)

blocks.zh: ISO 14937：其他滅菌方法（例如蒸汽、乾熱）的驗證通用要求
blocks.en: ISO 14937: general validation requirements for other sterilization methods (for example steam, dry heat)

blocks.zh: 每種滅菌方法都需要獨立的 IQ/OQ/PQ 驗證，並根據滅菌劑量、暴露時間、溫度/濕度等關鍵參數建立操作範圍。
blocks.en: Each sterilization method requires its own IQ/OQ/PQ validation, with operating ranges established according to critical parameters such as sterilization dose, exposure time and temperature/humidity.

blocks.zh: 比喻：醫院滅菌鍋的使用記錄
blocks.en: Analogy: A Hospital Autoclave Usage Log

blocks.zh: 就像醫院高壓滅菌鍋（Autoclave）每次使用都必須記錄溫度、壓力、時間，並將記錄與特定批次的手術器械掛勾——ISO 15378 要求包材廠的滅菌過程記錄也必須與每批包材「一對一」可追溯。若日後發現某批藥品有污染問題，稽查人員可以回溯至對應的滅菌批次記錄。
blocks.en: Just as a hospital autoclave must record temperature, pressure and time for every cycle and link the record to specific batches of surgical instruments, ISO 15378 requires that the packaging manufacturer's sterilization process records be traceable "one to one" to each batch of packaging material. If a contamination problem is later found in a batch of medicinal product, investigators can trace back to the corresponding sterilization batch record.

blocks.zh: 外包滅菌：責任不能外包
blocks.en: Outsourced Sterilization: Responsibility Cannot Be Outsourced

blocks.zh: 8.5.1.4.3 特別規定：即使組織將滅菌程序外包給第三方滅菌服務商，組織仍需確保外包商的程序符合 ISO 15378 要求。這意味著包材廠必須：
blocks.en: Clause 8.5.1.4.3 specifically provides that even if the organization outsources the sterilization process to a third-party sterilization service provider, the organization remains responsible for ensuring that the contractor's procedures meet the requirements of ISO 15378. This means the packaging manufacturer must:

blocks.zh: 審核外包滅菌商的資格與驗證文件
blocks.en: Audit the qualification and validation documents of the contract sterilizer

blocks.zh: 在合約中明確規定合規要求
blocks.en: Specify compliance requirements clearly in the contract

blocks.zh: 定期稽核外包商
blocks.en: Audit the contractor periodically

blocks.zh: 確保獲得每批次的滅菌記錄
blocks.en: Ensure that the sterilization records for every batch are obtained

blocks.zh: 「外包」不等於「免責」——這是 GMP 的基本原則。
blocks.en: "Outsourced" does not mean "not accountable". This is a basic GMP principle.

blocks.zh: 識別與追溯性 — 批次記錄、交叉污染防控與退回材料管理
blocks.en: Identification and Traceability: Batch Records, Cross-Contamination Prevention and Returned Material Management

blocks.zh: 追溯性（Traceability）在包材廠的實踐
blocks.en: Traceability in Practice at a Packaging Plant

blocks.zh: ISO 15378 要求從「原料來源」到「產品實現」的全鏈追溯。對包材廠而言，這表示：
blocks.en: ISO 15378 requires full-chain traceability from "raw material source" to "product realization". For a packaging plant, this means:

blocks.zh: 向上追溯：每批包材使用的原材料（樹脂、玻璃料、橡膠配方）批號
blocks.en: Upstream traceability: the lot numbers of the raw materials (resin, glass frit, rubber compound) used in each batch of packaging material

blocks.zh: 生產追溯：使用的設備（含校正狀態）、操作員、時間戳
blocks.en: Production traceability: the equipment used (including calibration status), the operators and the time stamps

blocks.zh: 向下追溯：該批包材出貨至哪家製藥廠、哪個批次
blocks.en: Downstream traceability: which pharmaceutical manufacturer and which batch each batch of packaging material was shipped to

blocks.zh: 這種雙向追溯系統讓藥品召回時，可在數小時內確定受影響的包材批次範圍。
blocks.en: This two-way traceability system allows the affected packaging batches to be identified within hours when a medicinal product is recalled.

blocks.zh: 唯一批號（Unique Batch Reference）的重要性
blocks.en: The Importance of a Unique Batch Reference

blocks.zh: 8.5.2.2.2 要求每批生產記錄必須有唯一識別碼。這不僅是文件管理的便利性問題，而是法規要求。當製藥廠客戶對某批包材進行調查（例如懷疑是包材導致藥品不合格），包材廠必須能快速調出完整的批次生產記錄，包括：原料批號、設備狀態、操作員、環境監控數據等。
blocks.en: Clause 8.5.2.2.2 requires that each batch production record have a unique identifier. This is not merely a matter of document management convenience; it is a regulatory requirement. When a pharmaceutical customer investigates a batch of packaging material (for example, suspecting that the packaging caused a medicinal product failure), the packaging manufacturer must be able to quickly retrieve the complete batch production record, including raw material lot numbers, equipment status, operators and environmental monitoring data.

blocks.zh: 8.5.2.2.3：設備使用記錄的「時序性」要求
blocks.en: 8.5.2.2.3: The "Chronological" Requirement for Equipment Use Records

blocks.zh: 這個條款特別要求設備使用記錄必須包含「清潔和維護活動的時序」——即按照實際發生的時間順序記錄。這是因為：
blocks.en: This clause specifically requires that equipment use records include the "sequence of cleaning and maintenance activities", that is, recorded in the actual order in which they occurred. This matters because:

blocks.zh: 若設備在某次生產後進行了緊急維修，然後立即投入下一批次生產，這個時序必須被記錄清楚。維修過程中是否可能引入污染物？維修後是否需要額外的清潔驗證？這些都需要追溯。
blocks.en: If equipment undergoes emergency repair after a production run and is then put straight into the next batch, this sequence must be clearly recorded. Could the repair have introduced contaminants? Is additional cleaning validation needed after the repair? All of this needs to be traceable.
Returned Material Management (8.5.2.2.4)

blocks.zh: 客戶退回的包材（例如品質問題退貨、調貨退回）必須與正常生產材料在物理上或系統上完全隔離，且必須有明確標識。這是防止「退回的不合格品被誤用於正常生產」的關鍵控制點。常見做法：設置專用退回材料暫存區（貼紅色「HOLD」標籤）+ ERP 系統隔離封存。
blocks.en: Packaging material returned by customers (for example returns for quality problems or exchange returns) must be physically or systemically fully segregated from normal production material and clearly identified. This is a key control point to prevent "returned nonconforming product from being used by mistake in normal production". Common practice: a dedicated holding area for returned material (with red "HOLD" labels) plus quarantine in the ERP system.

blocks.zh: 比喻：超市的 RFID 追蹤系統
blocks.en: Analogy: A Supermarket RFID Tracking System

blocks.zh: 現代超市用條碼/RFID 追蹤每個商品從供應商到貨架到收銀台的全過程——一旦發現問題食品，可在幾分鐘內確定哪些門店、哪些貨架有問題商品。ISO 15378 對包材的追溯要求原理相同，差別在於後果更嚴重：追蹤不到的包材批次可能導致藥品召回，甚至傷害患者。
blocks.en: Modern supermarkets use barcodes/RFID to track every item from supplier to shelf to checkout; once a problem food is found, they can determine within minutes which stores and which shelves hold the affected goods. The traceability requirements of ISO 15378 for packaging materials work on the same principle, but the consequences are more serious: a packaging batch that cannot be traced could lead to a medicinal product recall or even harm to patients.

blocks.zh: 客戶財產管理 & 產品保存與儲存的 GMP 特殊要求
blocks.en: Customer Property & Special GMP Requirements for Preservation and Storage of Product

blocks.zh: 8.5.3 客戶財產：包材廠常見的應用場景
blocks.en: 8.5.3 Customer Property: Common Scenarios in a Packaging Plant

blocks.zh: 在藥品包材業務中，「客戶財產」最常見的形式包括：
blocks.en: In the pharmaceutical packaging business, "customer property" most commonly takes these forms:

blocks.zh: 客供模具：製藥廠提供的專屬包材模具，包材廠使用後必須妥善保管
blocks.en: Customer-supplied molds: dedicated packaging molds supplied by the pharmaceutical manufacturer, which the packaging manufacturer must keep safe after use

blocks.zh: 客供原材料：製藥廠提供特定配方橡膠或樹脂讓包材廠加工
blocks.en: Customer-supplied raw materials: a specific rubber compound or resin supplied by the pharmaceutical manufacturer for the packaging manufacturer to process

blocks.zh: 知識產權：客戶的包材設計圖紙、技術規格（保密義務）
blocks.en: Intellectual property: the customer's packaging design drawings and technical specifications (subject to confidentiality obligations)

blocks.zh: 測試樣品：客戶送來用於相容性測試的藥品或藥液
blocks.en: Test samples: medicinal products or drug solutions sent by the customer for compatibility testing

blocks.zh: 任何客戶財產若發生損壞或遺失，必須立即通知客戶並保留書面記錄。
blocks.en: If any customer property is damaged or lost, the customer must be notified immediately and a written record kept.

blocks.zh: 保存系統（8.5.4.2.1）：有效期管理
blocks.en: Preservation System (8.5.4.2.1): Shelf-Life Management

blocks.zh: 許多包材（尤其是橡膠密封件、預滅菌包材）有明確的保質期——例如滅菌有效期（Shelf Life of Sterile Products）通常為 12–24 個月。ISO 15378 要求：
blocks.en: Many packaging materials (especially rubber closures and pre-sterilized packaging) have a defined shelf life; for example, the shelf life of sterile products is usually 12-24 months. ISO 15378 requires:

blocks.zh: 必須有書面程序追蹤有效期
blocks.en: A documented procedure must be in place to track expiry dates

blocks.zh: 超期材料必須隔離並處置
blocks.en: Expired material must be segregated and disposed of

blocks.zh: 保質期限必須有數據支持（穩定性研究）
blocks.en: The shelf life must be supported by data (stability studies)

blocks.zh: 交貨文件必須批次對應（8.5.4.2.2）
blocks.en: Delivery Documents Must Be Batch-Specific (8.5.4.2.2)

blocks.zh: 「交貨文件必須批次特定（batch-specific）」是 GMP 中的關鍵要求。每次出貨的送貨單必須對應到具體批號，而非僅列出產品名稱和數量。這確保制藥廠在進料收貨時能將實物與批次記錄匹配，是端到端追溯鏈的一環。
blocks.en: "Delivery documents must be batch-specific" is a key GMP requirement. The delivery note for each shipment must refer to specific batch numbers, not merely list the product name and quantity. This ensures that the pharmaceutical manufacturer can match the physical goods to the batch records at goods receipt, and it is one link in the end-to-end traceability chain.

blocks.zh: 重複使用包裝容器（8.5.4.2.3）
blocks.en: Reuse of Packaging Containers (8.5.4.2.3)

blocks.zh: 某些包材在配送時使用的週轉箱/容器可能被重複使用。ISO 15378 要求：若容器重複使用，舊標籤必須完全移除或塗銷（防止識別混淆），並按書面程序確認容器清潔。這看似微小的要求，實際上是防止「容器殘餘污染物」或「舊標籤引起識別錯誤」的重要控制。
blocks.en: The returnable crates/containers used to deliver some packaging materials may be reused. ISO 15378 requires that, if containers are reused, old labels be completely removed or obliterated (to prevent identification confusion) and that container cleanliness be verified according to a documented procedure. This seemingly minor requirement is in fact an important control against "residual contaminants in the container" and "identification errors caused by old labels".

blocks.zh: 交付後活動 & 變更控制 — GMP 的四項強化要求
blocks.en: Post-Delivery Activities & Change Control: Four Strengthened GMP Requirements

blocks.zh: 8.5.5 交付後活動：包材廠的義務範圍
blocks.en: 8.5.5 Post-Delivery Activities: The Scope of the Packaging Manufacturer's Obligations

blocks.zh: 「交付後活動」在包材廠情境中主要指：處理客戶投訴（交貨後發現品質問題）、提供技術支援（例如包材在客戶灌裝線的相容性問題）、保留樣品的長期管理、以及配合客戶進行已交付包材的法規調查或藥品召回。
blocks.en: In the context of a packaging plant, "post-delivery activities" mainly means: handling customer complaints (quality problems found after delivery); providing technical support (for example, compatibility issues of the packaging material on the customer's filling line); long-term management of retained samples; and cooperating with the customer in regulatory investigations or medicinal product recalls involving delivered packaging material.

blocks.zh: ISO 15378 要求在設計這些活動範圍時，必須考慮「潛在的不良後果」——也就是包材問題可能對患者造成的影響，這是風險導向思維的體現。
blocks.en: ISO 15378 requires that, in determining the scope of these activities, the "potential undesirable consequences" be considered, that is, the possible impact of a packaging problem on patients. This reflects risk-based thinking.

blocks.zh: 變更控制（Change Control）：GMP 中最重要的系統之一
blocks.en: Change Control: One of the Most Important Systems in GMP

blocks.zh: 8.5.6.2 的四項 GMP 附加要求勾勒出一個完整的變更控制系統架構：
blocks.en: The four additional GMP requirements of 8.5.6.2 outline a complete change control system architecture:

blocks.zh: 觸發：任何可能影響產品品質的變更（原料供應商、設備、製程參數、廠房）
blocks.en: Trigger: any change that may affect product quality (raw material supplier, equipment, process parameters, facility)

blocks.zh: 評估：風險評估 + 判斷是否需要驗證/再驗證
blocks.en: Evaluation: risk assessment plus a decision on whether validation/revalidation is needed

blocks.zh: 數據支持：需要生成支持性數據（如相容性測試、工程批次）
blocks.en: Supporting data: supporting data must be generated (such as compatibility tests and engineering batches)

blocks.zh: 批准：需要有授權職能（通常是 QA 部門）正式批准
blocks.en: Approval: formal approval by an authorized function (usually the QA department) is required

blocks.zh: 實施：在受控方式下執行，並通知客戶（若適用）
blocks.en: Implementation: carried out in a controlled manner, with notification of the customer (where applicable)

blocks.zh: 比喻：藥品製造商角度看包材變更
blocks.en: Analogy: Packaging Changes Seen from the Pharmaceutical Manufacturer's Side

blocks.zh: 想像你是製藥廠的 QA 主管。你的橡膠塞供應商突然通知說他們更換了橡膠配方。這個變更會影響：橡膠的提取物/浸出物（Extractables/Leachables）、密封力、與藥液的相容性。
blocks.en: Imagine you are the QA head at a pharmaceutical company. Your rubber stopper supplier suddenly tells you they have changed the rubber formulation. This change would affect the rubber's extractables/leachables, sealing force and compatibility with the drug solution.

blocks.zh: ISO 15378 要求包材廠在做這個變更前，必須先完成風險評估和必要的支持性數據，並通知客戶（製藥廠）。這就是為什麼許多藥品製造合同中要求「供應商未經批准不得擅自變更」。
blocks.en: ISO 15378 requires the packaging manufacturer to complete a risk assessment and the necessary supporting data before making such a change, and to notify the customer (the pharmaceutical manufacturer). This is why many pharmaceutical supply contracts state that "the supplier shall not make changes without approval".
8.5.6.2.4: Who Has the Authority to Approve Changes?

blocks.zh: 「Defined functions（指定職能）」通常指 Quality Assurance（QA）部門。這確保了變更批准不會僅由工程或生產部門主導——品質部門必須參與並有最終批准權。實務上，許多公司建立了「變更控制委員會（Change Control Board）」跨部門審查重大變更。
blocks.en: "Defined functions" usually means the Quality Assurance (QA) department. This ensures that approval of changes is not driven solely by engineering or production; the quality department must be involved and hold final approval authority. In practice, many companies set up a cross-functional Change Control Board to review major changes.

blocks.zh: 產品放行 — 批次文件審查與放行授權
blocks.en: Product Release: Batch Documentation Review and Release Authorization

blocks.zh: 批次放行（Batch Release）：包材廠的 QP 等效功能
blocks.en: Batch Release: The Packaging Plant's Equivalent of the QP Function

blocks.zh: 在製藥廠，批次放行由合格人（Qualified Person, QP）授權。ISO 15378 為包材廠建立了類似機制——批次必須通過文件審查後才能放行。這個審查通常包括：
blocks.en: In a pharmaceutical plant, batch release is authorized by the Qualified Person (QP). ISO 15378 establishes a similar mechanism for packaging plants: a batch can be released only after a documentation review. This review normally includes:

blocks.zh: 批次生產記錄（Batch Production Record）完整性確認
blocks.en: Confirmation that the Batch Production Record is complete

blocks.zh: 所有進料材料已通過進料檢驗
blocks.en: All incoming materials have passed incoming inspection

blocks.zh: 製程中控制（In-Process Controls）數據在規格內
blocks.en: In-process control data are within specification

blocks.zh: 最終檢驗（Final Inspection）結果符合規格
blocks.en: Final inspection results meet the specification

blocks.zh: 偏差（Deviations）已調查並關閉或已評估影響
blocks.en: Deviations have been investigated and closed, or their impact has been assessed

blocks.zh: 「放行前出貨」的允許條件
blocks.en: Conditions for "Shipment Prior to Release"

blocks.zh: ISO 15378（透過 9.1.3.5）允許在「客戶協議」下進行批次放行前出貨（Shipment Prior to Batch Release）。這種安排在業界常稱為 Preliminary Release 或 Ship-to-Test，常用於緊急供貨場景。但這需要書面的客戶合約條款支持，且最終批次放行結論必須補完。
blocks.en: ISO 15378 (through 9.1.3.5) permits shipment prior to batch release under a "customer agreement". This arrangement is commonly called Preliminary Release or Ship-to-Test in the industry and is often used in urgent supply situations. However, it must be supported by written customer contract terms, and the final batch release conclusion must be completed afterwards.

blocks.zh: 比喻：銀行的雙簽制度
blocks.en: Analogy: The Bank's Dual-Signature System

blocks.zh: 批次放行就像銀行的大額轉帳需要雙重授權——即使所有文件都準備好了，也必須有授權人員的簽名確認，才能讓貨物「出閘」進入客戶手中。這個授權記錄（誰在何時批准了哪個批次）是事後稽查的關鍵證據。
blocks.en: Batch release is like a large bank transfer that requires dual authorization: even when all the documents are ready, an authorized person must sign to confirm before the goods can "go out the gate" to the customer. This authorization record (who approved which batch, and when) is key evidence for any later audit.

blocks.zh: 不合格品管制 — 隔離、特許放行、處置三條路徑
blocks.en: Nonconforming Product Control: Segregation, Concession and Disposition, Three Pathways

blocks.zh: 不合格品的三條路徑
blocks.en: The Three Pathways for Nonconforming Product

blocks.zh: 發現不合格品後，ISO 15378 提供三種處理選項：
blocks.en: Once nonconforming product is found, ISO 15378 provides three handling options:

blocks.zh: 矯正/返工（Correction/Rework）：修復後重新驗證是否符合規格（最常見）
blocks.en: Correction/Rework: repair, then re-verify conformity to the specification (the most common)

blocks.zh: 特許放行（Concession/Waiver）：在客戶書面授權下，接受不完全符合規格的材料（需記錄）
blocks.en: Concession/Waiver: with written customer authorization, accept material that does not fully meet the specification (must be recorded)

blocks.zh: 銷毀/處置（Disposal/Destruction）：當無法矯正且客戶不接受特許時，按書面程序銷毀
blocks.en: Disposal/Destruction: when it cannot be corrected and the customer does not accept a concession, destroy it according to a documented procedure

blocks.zh: 特許放行（Concession）：必須客戶授權
blocks.en: Concession: Customer Authorization Is Required

blocks.zh: 特許放行是 GMP 中一個受嚴格管制的概念。ISO 15378 明確要求：任何不合格品的特許放行，必須由客戶書面授權，不能由包材廠單方面決定。
blocks.en: Concession is a strictly controlled concept in GMP. ISO 15378 explicitly requires that any concession for nonconforming product be authorized in writing by the customer; it cannot be decided unilaterally by the packaging manufacturer.

blocks.zh: 這反映了一個重要的責任分配原則：不合格品能否被接受使用，最終使用者（製藥廠）必須知情並同意，因為使用不合格包材的風險由製藥廠的最終產品承擔。
blocks.en: This reflects an important principle of allocating responsibility: the end user (the pharmaceutical manufacturer) must be informed of and agree to whether nonconforming product may be used, because the risk of using nonconforming packaging material is borne by the pharmaceutical manufacturer's finished product.

blocks.zh: 交付後發現的不合格品
blocks.en: Nonconforming Product Detected After Delivery

blocks.zh: 8.7.1 特別涵蓋「交付後發現的不合格品」——即包材已到達客戶手中，甚至已用於藥品生產後，才發現問題。這種情況下，包材廠必須：迅速通知客戶、保留調查記錄、配合客戶評估影響範圍，並採取 CAPA。這直接連接到 Section 10 的客戶投訴處理程序。
blocks.en: Clause 8.7.1 specifically covers "nonconforming product detected after delivery", that is, where a problem is found only after the packaging material has reached the customer or even been used in medicinal product manufacture. In this case, the packaging manufacturer must: notify the customer promptly, keep investigation records, cooperate with the customer in assessing the scope of impact, and take CAPA. This links directly to the customer complaint handling procedure in Section 10.

blocks.zh: 比喻：汽車零件的召回流程
blocks.en: Analogy: The Automotive Parts Recall Process

blocks.zh: 汽車零件供應商發現已交付的零件有缺陷時，不能自行決定「沒事」繼續出貨——必須立即通知汽車廠（客戶），並由汽車廠決定如何處置已安裝到車輛上的零件。ISO 15378 對包材的要求遵循相同邏輯。
blocks.en: When an automotive parts supplier discovers that delivered parts are defective, it cannot decide on its own that "it is fine" and keep shipping. It must notify the automaker (the customer) immediately, and the automaker decides how to deal with parts already installed in vehicles. ISO 15378 follows the same logic for packaging materials.

blocks.zh: 第9節概覽：監測、測量、分析與評估的完整框架
blocks.en: Section 9 Overview: A Complete Framework for Monitoring, Measurement, Analysis and Evaluation

blocks.zh: Section 9 的三大支柱
blocks.en: The Three Pillars of Section 9

blocks.zh: ISO 15378 第 9 節建立了績效評估的完整架構，分三個主要層面：
blocks.en: Section 9 of ISO 15378 establishes a complete performance evaluation architecture at three main levels:

blocks.zh: 9.1 監測與評估：日常數據收集、OOS 調查、進料/製程/批次控制
blocks.en: 9.1 Monitoring and evaluation: routine data collection, OOS investigation, incoming/in-process/batch controls

blocks.zh: 9.2 內部稽核：系統性定期稽核 QMS 合規性
blocks.en: 9.2 Internal audit: systematic, periodic audit of QMS compliance

blocks.zh: 9.3 管理審查：高層定期評估 QMS 整體有效性
blocks.en: 9.3 Management review: periodic evaluation by top management of the overall effectiveness of the QMS

blocks.zh: 這三個層面形成一個由下而上的品質監控體系：日常數據 → 稽核發現 → 管理層決策。
blocks.en: These three levels form a bottom-up quality monitoring system: routine data → audit findings → management decisions.

blocks.zh: 客戶滿意度監測（9.1.2）在包材業務的實踐
blocks.en: Customer Satisfaction Monitoring (9.1.2) in the Packaging Business

blocks.zh: 對包材廠而言，客戶滿意度的關鍵指標通常包括：批次拒收率（Batch Rejection Rate）、客戶投訴數量與嚴重性、交期達成率（On-Time Delivery Rate）、品質偏差通知（Quality Notifications）的回應時間。
blocks.en: For a packaging plant, the key customer satisfaction indicators typically include: batch rejection rate, the number and severity of customer complaints, on-time delivery rate, and response time to quality notifications.

blocks.zh: 許多大型製藥廠客戶對供應商有定期的「Supplier Scorecard」評分系統，這些分數直接回饋到包材廠的客戶滿意度監測數據。
blocks.en: Many large pharmaceutical customers run a regular "Supplier Scorecard" rating system for their suppliers, and these scores feed directly into the packaging plant's customer satisfaction monitoring data.

blocks.zh: 分析與評估 — 超規結果調查（OOS）、進料檢驗、製程中控制
blocks.en: Analysis and Evaluation: Out-of-Specification (OOS) Investigation, Incoming Inspection, In-Process Controls

blocks.zh: OOS 調查（9.1.3.2）：GMP 的強制要求
blocks.en: OOS Investigation (9.1.3.2): A Mandatory GMP Requirement

blocks.zh: 「超規結果（Out-of-Specification, OOS）調查」是美國 FDA 21 CFR Part 211 和 EU GMP 中的核心要求，ISO 15378 將其納入包材廠的義務範圍。OOS 調查的基本程序：
blocks.en: Out-of-specification (OOS) investigation is a core requirement of US FDA 21 CFR Part 211 and EU GMP, and ISO 15378 brings it within the obligations of packaging plants. The basic OOS investigation procedure is:

blocks.zh: 第一步（實驗室調查）：確認是否為計算錯誤、儀器故障、操作員失誤等可辨識的實驗室錯誤
blocks.en: Step 1 (laboratory investigation): confirm whether there is an identifiable laboratory error such as a calculation error, instrument malfunction or operator error

blocks.zh: 第二步（製造調查）：若無法排除實驗室原因，擴大至生產過程調查
blocks.en: Step 2 (manufacturing investigation): if a laboratory cause cannot be ruled out, extend the investigation to the production process

blocks.zh: 結論：確認 OOS 有效性，採取 CAPA，決定批次處置
blocks.en: Conclusion: confirm the validity of the OOS result, take CAPA and decide the disposition of the batch

blocks.zh: 關鍵：OOS 調查必須有書面程序，且每次調查結果必須記錄歸檔。
blocks.en: Key point: OOS investigations must have a documented procedure, and the result of every investigation must be recorded and filed.

blocks.zh: 進料檢驗（9.1.3.3）：包材廠的兩種方式
blocks.en: Incoming Inspection (9.1.3.3): Two Approaches in a Packaging Plant

blocks.zh: ISO 15378 要求對「所有使用材料」建立進料要求，並進行「檢驗或其他方式的符合性確認」。「其他方式」通常指：
blocks.en: ISO 15378 requires that incoming requirements be established for "all materials used" and that "inspection or other means of verifying conformity" be carried out. "Other means" usually refers to:

blocks.zh: 供應商釋放憑證（Certificate of Analysis, CoA）：對經批准的合格供應商，接受 CoA 代替每批檢驗（需有定期稽核做後盾）
blocks.en: Supplier release certificate (Certificate of Analysis, CoA): for approved, qualified suppliers, accepting the CoA in place of batch-by-batch inspection (backed by periodic audits)

blocks.zh: 跳批抽樣（Skip-Lot Testing）：對歷史記錄良好的供應商，降低抽樣頻率（需書面驗證）
blocks.en: Skip-lot testing: for suppliers with a good history, reducing the sampling frequency (requires documented justification)

blocks.zh: 製程中控制的三個關鍵點
blocks.en: Three Key Points of In-Process Control

blocks.zh: 代表性樣品（9.1.3.4.2）：抽樣必須代表整個製程——例如在注塑成型中，每個模腔都可能有不同的製程特性，抽樣計劃必須覆蓋所有模腔。
blocks.en: Representative samples (9.1.3.4.2): sampling must represent the whole process; for example, in injection molding each cavity may have different process characteristics, so the sampling plan must cover all cavities.

blocks.zh: 樣品不得返回（9.1.3.4.2）：移出生產區的樣品不得送回——因為樣品可能在測試過程中受到污染或破損。
blocks.en: Samples must not be returned (9.1.3.4.2): samples removed from the production area must not be put back, because they may have been contaminated or damaged during testing.

blocks.zh: 設備故障後的額外控制（9.1.3.4.3）：設備故障或非計劃停機後，必須進行額外的製程中控制，確認恢復生產後的品質穩定性。
blocks.en: Additional controls after equipment failure (9.1.3.4.3): after an equipment failure or unplanned stoppage, additional in-process controls must be performed to confirm that quality is stable once production resumes.

blocks.zh: 比喻：品質管控層次金字塔
blocks.en: Analogy: The Quality Control Pyramid

blocks.zh: 進料檢驗（9.1.3.3）是第一道防線；製程中控制（9.1.3.4）是製造過程中的即時監測；最終檢驗（9.1.3.5）是出貨前的最後確認。OOS 調查貫穿所有層次——任何一個層次發現超規，都必須觸發系統性調查，而不僅僅是「重測一次」。
blocks.en: Incoming inspection (9.1.3.3) is the first line of defense; in-process control (9.1.3.4) is real-time monitoring during manufacture; final inspection (9.1.3.5) is the last confirmation before shipment. OOS investigation runs through all levels: an OOS result at any level must trigger a systematic investigation, not just "retest once".

blocks.zh: 批次放行、保留樣品與製程數據的開放原則
blocks.en: Batch Release, Retained Samples and the Principle of Open Process Data

blocks.zh: 批次放行：文件審查的核心
blocks.en: Batch Release: The Core of Documentation Review

blocks.zh: ISO 15378 強調批次放行必須包含批次文件審查（Review of Batch Documentation）。這不僅僅是確認最終檢驗通過，而是全面審查整個批次的生產歷史：
blocks.en: ISO 15378 stresses that batch release must include a Review of Batch Documentation. This is not merely confirming that final inspection passed; it is a comprehensive review of the whole production history of the batch:

blocks.zh: 原料進料記錄 + CoA
blocks.en: Raw material receipt records + CoA

blocks.zh: 生產批次記錄（設備、參數、操作員）
blocks.en: Production batch record (equipment, parameters, operators)

blocks.zh: 製程中控制數據
blocks.en: In-process control data

blocks.zh: 偏差記錄（若有）及其評估
blocks.en: Deviation records (if any) and their evaluation

blocks.zh: 最終檢驗報告
blocks.en: Final inspection report

blocks.zh: 環境監控數據（若適用）
blocks.en: Environmental monitoring data (if applicable)

blocks.zh: Note 2 的重要性：風險導向放行（RTRT）
blocks.en: The Significance of Note 2: Risk-Based Release (RTRT)

blocks.zh: 9.1.3.5 的 NOTE 2 暗示了現代 GMP 中「即時放行測試（Real-Time Release Testing, RTRT）」的概念——最終檢驗不必測試所有規格參數，只要控制系統和控制策略可以保證品質。這與 ICH Q8/Q10 的製程分析技術（PAT）和 QbD 方法論一致。
blocks.en: NOTE 2 of 9.1.3.5 alludes to the modern GMP concept of Real-Time Release Testing (RTRT): final inspection does not need to test every specification parameter as long as the control system and control strategy can assure quality. This is consistent with the process analytical technology (PAT) and QbD approaches of ICH Q8/Q10.

blocks.zh: 保留樣品（Retained Samples）的用途
blocks.en: The Purpose of Retained Samples

blocks.zh: 保留樣品是出貨批次的「時間膠囊」。在客戶日後提出投訴或出現問題時，保留樣品可用於：
blocks.en: Retained samples are the "time capsule" of a shipped batch. When a customer later raises a complaint or a problem arises, retained samples can be used to:

blocks.zh: 重新測試原批次品質（確認出廠時是否合格）
blocks.en: Retest the quality of the original batch (to confirm it was conforming at release)

blocks.zh: 進行客戶報告中描述問題的還原試驗
blocks.en: Carry out reproduction tests of the problem described in the customer report

blocks.zh: 藥品召回調查的參考依據
blocks.en: Serve as a reference for medicinal product recall investigations

blocks.zh: 保留樣品的數量、儲存條件、保存期限通常由客戶合約或內部規程規定（通常為產品有效期限後至少 1 年）。
blocks.en: The quantity, storage conditions and retention period of retained samples are usually specified in the customer contract or internal procedures (usually at least 1 year beyond the product shelf life).

blocks.zh: 9.1.3.7 製程數據開放原則
blocks.en: 9.1.3.7 The Principle of Open Process Data

blocks.zh: 客戶有權要求查閱生產和控制數據以驗證製程合規性——但「不包括組織的機密知識產權」。這在實務上需要仔細界定：哪些數據可以共享（如生產記錄、檢驗數據），哪些屬於商業機密（如配方配比、特殊製程技術）。供應商協議（Quality Technical Agreement）通常會事先約定數據共享範圍。
blocks.en: Customers have the right to request access to production and control data to verify process compliance, but this "does not include the organization's confidential intellectual property". In practice this needs careful definition: which data can be shared (such as production records and test data) and which are trade secrets (such as formulation ratios and special process technology). A Quality Technical Agreement usually agrees the scope of data sharing in advance.

blocks.zh: 內部稽核 — 頻率、方法、客觀性與後續行動
blocks.en: Internal Audit: Frequency, Method, Objectivity and Follow-Up

blocks.zh: ISO 15378 內部稽核的雙重目的
blocks.en: The Dual Purpose of Internal Audit in ISO 15378

blocks.zh: 9.2.1 清楚列出內部稽核的兩個目的：確認符合 ISO 15378 要求（合規確認），以及確認 QMS 是否有效實施和維持（有效性評估）。
blocks.en: Clause 9.2.1 clearly lists two purposes of internal audit: to confirm conformity to the requirements of ISO 15378 (compliance confirmation), and to confirm that the QMS is effectively implemented and maintained (effectiveness evaluation).

blocks.zh: 許多組織的內部稽核只關注「有沒有這個程序」，而忽略「這個程序是否真正有效運作」。ISO 15378 要求兩者並重。
blocks.en: Many organizations' internal audits only look at "whether the procedure exists" and ignore "whether the procedure actually works effectively". ISO 15378 requires equal attention to both.

blocks.zh: 稽核程序計劃的四個考量維度（9.2.2.a）
blocks.en: Four Considerations for the Audit Program (9.2.2.a)

blocks.zh: 制定年度內部稽核計劃時，必須考量：
blocks.en: When drawing up the annual internal audit plan, the following must be considered:

blocks.zh: 製程重要性：高風險製程（如滅菌、潔淨室生產）稽核頻率應更高
blocks.en: Importance of the process: high-risk processes (such as sterilization and cleanroom production) should be audited more frequently

blocks.zh: 組織變化：新廠房、新設備、人員異動後需要優先稽核
blocks.en: Organizational changes: new facilities, new equipment and staff changes need to be audited as a priority

blocks.zh: 歷史稽核結果：上次發現重大不合格的領域需要加強追蹤
blocks.en: Results of previous audits: areas where major nonconformities were found last time need stronger follow-up

blocks.zh: 客戶稽核/法規檢查結果：外部稽核發現應納入內部稽核重點
blocks.en: Customer audit/regulatory inspection results: external audit findings should be built into the focus of internal audits

blocks.zh: 客觀性與公正性（9.2.2.c）
blocks.en: Objectivity and Impartiality (9.2.2.c)

blocks.zh: 稽核員不能稽核自己負責的工作領域——這是最基本的獨立性要求。在人數較少的組織中，這往往是一個挑戰，常見解決方法包括：交叉稽核（不同部門互相稽核）、聘請外部稽核員補充內部稽核、建立稽核員資格要求確保專業能力。
blocks.en: Auditors must not audit their own area of work; this is the most basic independence requirement. In organizations with few staff this is often a challenge, and common solutions include: cross-auditing (different departments audit each other), engaging external auditors to supplement internal audits, and setting auditor qualification requirements to ensure competence.

blocks.zh: 比喻：財務年度審計
blocks.en: Analogy: The Annual Financial Audit

blocks.zh: 內部稽核就像企業的內部財務審計——不是等到外部稽查才發現問題，而是主動、定期地自我檢查。差別在於：財務審計關注金流合規，GMP 內部稽核關注品質系統合規。兩者都需要獨立性，結果都需要報告給管理層，發現問題都需要在合理時間內糾正。
blocks.en: Internal audit is like a company's internal financial audit: rather than waiting for an external inspection to find problems, it is a proactive, regular self-check. The difference is that a financial audit looks at the compliance of cash flows, while a GMP internal audit looks at the compliance of the quality system. Both need independence, both report results to management, and in both, problems found must be corrected within a reasonable time.

blocks.zh: 管理審查 — 輸入項目、輸出決策與高層責任
blocks.en: Management Review: Inputs, Output Decisions and Top Management Responsibility

blocks.zh: 管理審查：高層的 QMS 年度健康檢查
blocks.en: Management Review: The Top Management's Annual Health Check of the QMS

blocks.zh: 管理審查（Management Review）是高層管理者定期評估整個 QMS 是否仍然適合、充分且有效的正式機制。注意：這不是品質部門的事——「Top management（最高管理層）」必須親自參與。
blocks.en: Management review is the formal mechanism by which top management periodically evaluates whether the whole QMS remains suitable, adequate and effective. Note that this is not a matter for the quality department alone: "Top management" must take part personally.

blocks.zh: 對包材廠而言，管理審查通常每年至少進行一次（大型或複雜組織可能半年一次），並產生書面的管理審查記錄和行動計劃。
blocks.en: For a packaging plant, management review is normally held at least once a year (large or complex organizations may hold it every six months), and produces a written management review record and an action plan.

blocks.zh: 9.3.2(g) 訓練有效性：ISO 15378 的附加項目
blocks.en: 9.3.2(g) Effectiveness of Training: An ISO 15378 Addition

blocks.zh: 值得注意的是，ISO 15378 在管理審查輸入中加入了 g) 「訓練有效性（effectiveness of training）」——這是比 ISO 9001:2015 基礎版本多的一個輸入項目，反映了 GMP 對人員能力和訓練的高度重視。管理層需要評估：訓練計劃是否真的提升了員工能力，而不只是紙面上的訓練時數達標。
blocks.en: It is worth noting that ISO 15378 adds item g), "effectiveness of training", to the management review inputs. This is one more input than in the base ISO 9001:2015 and reflects the great importance GMP places on personnel competence and training. Management needs to evaluate whether the training program has really improved employee competence, and not just whether the paper target for training hours has been met.

blocks.zh: 輸入 vs. 輸出：管理審查的邏輯閉環
blocks.en: Inputs vs. Outputs: The Closed Logic Loop of Management Review

blocks.zh: ISO 15378 對管理審查採用 PDCA 邏輯：
blocks.en: ISO 15378 applies PDCA logic to management review:

blocks.zh: 輸入（9.3.2）：收集過去一年的品質績效數據
blocks.en: Inputs (9.3.2): collect the quality performance data of the past year

blocks.zh: 審查（9.3.1）：最高管理層評估數據、識別問題和機會
blocks.en: Review (9.3.1): top management evaluates the data and identifies problems and opportunities

blocks.zh: 輸出（9.3.3）：做出決策——需要哪些改善？需要什麼資源？需要哪些 QMS 變更？
blocks.en: Outputs (9.3.3): make decisions: what improvements are needed? what resources are needed? what QMS changes are needed?

blocks.zh: 輸出必須包含具體決策和行動，不能只是「討論了一下，沒什麼大問題」。下次管理審查的第一個輸入項目（9.3.2.a）就是追蹤上次決議的執行狀況。
blocks.en: The outputs must include specific decisions and actions, not just "we talked about it and there is nothing much to worry about". The first input of the next management review (9.3.2.a) is the status of actions from the previous review.

blocks.zh: 比喻：董事會年度報告
blocks.en: Analogy: The Board of Directors' Annual Report

blocks.zh: 管理審查的結構與企業董事會年度報告類似——回顧上一年的表現（財務指標 → 品質指標），評估內外部環境變化，決定來年的資源投入和戰略調整。差別在於：管理審查的「指標」是品質績效數據（不合格率、客訴數量、稽核發現），而「戰略調整」是 QMS 改善計劃。
blocks.en: The structure of management review is similar to a company board's annual report: review the previous year's performance (financial indicators → quality indicators), assess changes in the internal and external environment, and decide resource allocation and strategic adjustments for the coming year. The difference is that the "indicators" of management review are quality performance data (nonconformity rate, number of complaints, audit findings), and the "strategic adjustments" are the QMS improvement plan.

blocks.zh: 第10節：改善 — 不符合項、矯正預防行動（CAPA）與持續改善
blocks.en: Section 10: Improvement: Nonconformity, Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) and Continual Improvement

blocks.zh: Section 10 的三個層次
blocks.en: The Three Levels of Section 10

blocks.zh: ISO 15378 第 10 節的改善框架有三個遞進層次：
blocks.en: The improvement framework in Section 10 of ISO 15378 has three progressive levels:

blocks.zh: 矯正（Correction）：針對已發生問題的即時修復（治標）
blocks.en: Correction: immediate fixing of a problem that has already occurred (treating the symptom)

blocks.zh: 矯正行動（Corrective Action）：消除不符合的根本原因，防止再發（治本）
blocks.en: Corrective Action: eliminating the root cause of the nonconformity to prevent recurrence (treating the cause)

blocks.zh: 持續改善（Continual Improvement）：主動識別並實施提升機會，即使目前沒有問題（超越合規）
blocks.en: Continual Improvement: proactively identifying and implementing opportunities for improvement even when there is currently no problem (going beyond compliance)

blocks.zh: GMP 要求的是三個層次都必須有，而不是只有矯正。
blocks.en: GMP requires that all three levels be in place, not just correction.

blocks.zh: CAPA 的六步驟閉環（10.2.1）
blocks.en: The Closed-Loop CAPA Process (10.2.1)

blocks.zh: 10.2.1 實際上描述了完整的 CAPA 閉環流程：
blocks.en: Clause 10.2.1 in fact describes a complete closed-loop CAPA process:

blocks.zh: 即時反應：控制並矯正不符合，處理後果
blocks.en: Immediate response: control and correct the nonconformity, and deal with the consequences

blocks.zh: 根本原因分析：不只是「發生了什麼」，要找到「為什麼發生」
blocks.en: Root cause analysis: not just "what happened" but "why it happened"

blocks.zh: 橫向延伸：確認類似問題是否在其他地方存在或可能發生
blocks.en: Extension to other areas: determine whether similar problems exist or could occur elsewhere

blocks.zh: 實施行動：執行根本原因消除措施
blocks.en: Implement action: carry out the measures that eliminate the root cause

blocks.zh: 有效性確認：驗證矯正行動真的有效（最常被忽略的步驟）
blocks.en: Effectiveness check: verify that the corrective action really worked (the step most often overlooked)

blocks.zh: 更新 QMS：若必要，更新風險評估、程序文件或 QMS
blocks.en: Update the QMS: if necessary, update the risk assessment, procedure documents or the QMS

blocks.zh: 10.2.3 — Additional GMP-Related Requirements (p51) 10.2.3 — 額外的 GMP 相關要求（p51）
blocks.en: 10.2.3 — Additional GMP-Related Requirements (p51)

blocks.zh: 10.2.3(c)：潔淨室返工的強制要求
blocks.en: 10.2.3(c): Mandatory Requirement for Rework in the Cleanroom

blocks.zh: 這是 ISO 15378 中一個非常具體且嚴格的要求：如果包材是在潔淨室環境下生產的，返工也必須在相同的潔淨室條件下進行。
blocks.en: This is a very specific and strict requirement in ISO 15378: if the packaging material is produced in a cleanroom environment, rework must also be carried out under the same cleanroom conditions.

blocks.zh: 這是因為：潔淨室生產的包材（例如預滅菌器具）的品質保證依賴於潔淨環境。若在普通環境下返工，即使包材外觀修復，潔淨度可能已受損，不能作為替代。
blocks.en: This is because the quality assurance of cleanroom-produced packaging material (for example pre-sterilized components) depends on the clean environment. If rework is done in an ordinary environment, then even if the appearance of the material is restored, its cleanliness may already be compromised, and this cannot be accepted as a substitute.

blocks.zh: 10.2.3(d)：特許放行必須客戶書面授權
blocks.en: 10.2.3(d): Concession Must Be Authorized in Writing by the Customer

blocks.zh: 此條款與 8.7.1(d) 呼應，再次強調：不合格品的特許放行（Concession）必須由客戶書面授權。「我們內部評估認為可以接受」不夠——客戶必須知情並授權。
blocks.en: This clause echoes 8.7.1(d) and stresses once more that a concession for nonconforming product must be authorized in writing by the customer. "Our internal assessment is that it is acceptable" is not enough; the customer must be informed and give authorization.

blocks.zh: 這在供應鏈中具有重要意義：客戶（製藥廠）有義務在接受特許放行後，將此資訊反映在其自身的批次記錄中，並評估對最終藥品品質的影響。
blocks.en: This has important implications in the supply chain: after accepting a concession, the customer (the pharmaceutical manufacturer) is obliged to reflect this information in its own batch records and to assess the impact on the quality of the final medicinal product.

blocks.zh: 10.2.3(g)：客戶投訴處理的時效要求
blocks.en: 10.2.3(g): Time Requirements for Customer Complaint Handling

blocks.zh: 「及時（timely manner）」和「盡快可行（as soon as practical）」是 ISO 15378 的措辭。雖然沒有硬性規定具體天數，但 GMP 行業慣例通常是：初步確認回覆 24–48 小時內；初步調查報告 5–10 個工作日；最終 CAPA 報告 30 天內。這些時限通常會在客戶與供應商的品質技術協議（QTA）中明確規定。
blocks.en: "In a timely manner" and "as soon as practical" are the wording used in ISO 15378. Although no specific number of days is prescribed, the usual industry practice in GMP is: initial acknowledgment within 24-48 hours; preliminary investigation report within 5-10 working days; final CAPA report within 30 days. These time limits are usually specified explicitly in the Quality Technical Agreement (QTA) between customer and supplier.

blocks.zh: 10.2.3(h)：「不行動」也需要理由
blocks.en: 10.2.3(h): "No Action" Also Needs a Justification

blocks.zh: 這是一個常被忽略的要求：即使組織判斷某個客戶投訴不需要採取矯正或預防行動，這個判斷本身也必須書面記錄並說明理由。不能簡單地「關閉投訴記錄」而不留下處置決定的依據。
blocks.en: This is a frequently overlooked requirement: even if the organization determines that a customer complaint does not require corrective or preventive action, that decision itself must be documented with the reasons stated. The complaint record cannot simply be "closed" without leaving the basis for the disposition decision.

blocks.zh: 持續改善 — 超越合規，建立品質文化
blocks.en: Continual Improvement: Going Beyond Compliance and Building a Quality Culture

blocks.zh: 持續改善 vs. 矯正行動的本質差異
blocks.en: The Essential Difference between Continual Improvement and Corrective Action

blocks.zh: 許多組織混淆了「矯正行動（Corrective Action）」和「持續改善（Continual Improvement）」：
blocks.en: Many organizations confuse "Corrective Action" with "Continual Improvement":

blocks.zh: 矯正行動：由已發生的不符合觸發，目的是消除根本原因，防止再發——這是被動的
blocks.en: Corrective action: triggered by a nonconformity that has already occurred, and aims to eliminate the root cause and prevent recurrence; it is reactive

blocks.zh: 持續改善：主動識別提升機會，即使目前沒有問題——這是主動的
blocks.en: Continual improvement: proactively identifies opportunities for enhancement even when there is currently no problem; it is proactive

blocks.zh: ISO 15378 要求組織建立的是持續改善文化，而不只是「有問題才修」。
blocks.en: ISO 15378 requires the organization to build a culture of continual improvement, not just "fix it when something goes wrong".

blocks.zh: 持續改善的變更也需要風險管理
blocks.en: Changes from Continual Improvement Also Need Risk Management

blocks.zh: 10.3 最後一句非常重要：「持續改善所提出的變更必須接受風險管理（risk management）。」
blocks.en: The last sentence of 10.3 is very important: "Changes proposed by continual improvement must be subject to risk management."

blocks.zh: 這意味著：即使是「出於好意的改善」，也可能引入未預見的風險。例如，為了提高生產效率而修改生產流程，可能在無意中影響包材品質。每一個改善提案都必須經過風險評估，並連接到 8.5.6 的變更控制程序。
blocks.en: This means that even a "well-intentioned improvement" may introduce unforeseen risks. For example, modifying a production process to increase efficiency could inadvertently affect the quality of the packaging material. Every improvement proposal must go through risk assessment and be linked to the change control procedure in 8.5.6.

blocks.zh: 比喻：精益生產（Lean）+ 品質管理的結合
blocks.en: Analogy: Combining Lean Production and Quality Management

blocks.zh: 持續改善的概念源自日本的「改善（Kaizen）」文化——每天都在尋找小的改進機會。在製藥包材業，這意味著：不只等到客戶投訴才改變，而是主動分析製程數據（SPC 統計製程管制）、找出正在漂移但仍在規格內的趨勢，在問題爆發前就採取預防行動。
blocks.en: The concept of continual improvement originates from the Japanese culture of "Kaizen", looking for small opportunities to improve every day. In the pharmaceutical packaging industry this means: not waiting for a customer complaint before making a change, but proactively analyzing process data (SPC, statistical process control), finding trends that are drifting but still within specification, and taking preventive action before the problem erupts.

blocks.zh: 這就是 CAPA 中的 PA（Preventive Action） 的本質——預防，而非僅矯正。
blocks.en: This is the essence of the PA (Preventive Action) in CAPA: prevention, not just correction.

blocks.zh: 本節重點總結 — ISO 15378 生產後半段、績效評估與改善的核心要點
blocks.en: Section Summary: Key Points on the Second Half of Production, Performance Evaluation and Improvement in ISO 15378

blocks.zh: 本節核心洞見 / Core Insights
blocks.en: Core Insights

blocks.zh: 洞見 1：責任不可外包
blocks.en: Insight 1: Responsibility Cannot Be Outsourced

blocks.zh: 貫穿本節的一個主題是：無論滅菌驗證、特許放行、還是返工——責任永遠在組織本身，不會因為外包或客戶授權而消失。包材廠是品質鏈上的一個關鍵節點，其品質決策對下游製藥廠和最終患者都有直接影響。
blocks.en: A theme running through this section is that, whether it is sterilization validation, concession or rework, responsibility always remains with the organization itself and does not disappear through outsourcing or customer authorization. The packaging manufacturer is a key node in the quality chain, and its quality decisions have a direct impact on the downstream pharmaceutical manufacturer and the end patient.

blocks.zh: 洞見 2：ISO 15378 的 GMP 附加要求都指向同一件事
blocks.en: Insight 2: All the Additional GMP Requirements in ISO 15378 Point to the Same Thing

blocks.zh: 仔細審視 Section 8–10 的所有 GMP 附加要求，可以發現它們都指向同一目標：確保每一批交到製藥廠手中的包材，都有完整、可追溯的品質保證記錄，讓製藥廠可以相信這批材料不會危害患者。
blocks.en: On careful review of all the additional GMP requirements in Sections 8-10, they can be seen to point to the same goal: to ensure that every batch of packaging material delivered to a pharmaceutical manufacturer carries complete, traceable quality assurance records, so that the pharmaceutical manufacturer can trust that the material will not endanger patients.

blocks.zh: 這就是為什麼 ISO 15378 比普通的 ISO 9001 難以通過認證——它要求的不只是「有程序」，而是「有效執行的、有記錄的、可稽查的品質保證系統」。
blocks.en: This is why ISO 15378 is harder to get certified to than ordinary ISO 9001: it requires not just "having procedures" but a quality assurance system that is effectively implemented, documented and auditable.

blocks.zh: 洞見 3：Section 9 和 10 形成閉環
blocks.en: Insight 3: Sections 9 and 10 Form a Closed Loop

blocks.zh: Section 9（績效評估）收集數據 → Section 10（改善）利用數據驅動行動。這個閉環是 ISO 管理體系 PDCA 邏輯的體現：
blocks.en: Section 9 (Performance evaluation) collects data, and Section 10 (Improvement) uses the data to drive action. This closed loop embodies the PDCA logic of ISO management systems:

blocks.zh: P（計劃）：Sections 6–8 建立策略和流程
blocks.en: P (Plan): Sections 6-8 establish strategy and processes

blocks.zh: D（執行）：Section 8 的操作要求
blocks.en: D (Do): the operational requirements of Section 8

blocks.zh: C（檢查）：Section 9 的績效評估
blocks.en: C (Check): the performance evaluation of Section 9

blocks.zh: A（行動）：Section 10 的改善措施
blocks.en: A (Act): the improvement measures of Section 10

blocks.zh: 實務思考題
blocks.en: Practical Discussion Questions

blocks.zh: 假設你是一家為製藥廠供應預充填注射器筒的包材廠 QA 主管：
blocks.en: Suppose you are the QA head of a packaging plant that supplies pre-filled syringe barrels to pharmaceutical manufacturers:

blocks.zh: 你的年度內部稽核計劃如何設計才符合 9.2 要求？
blocks.en: How would you design your annual internal audit plan so that it meets the requirements of 9.2?

blocks.zh: 客戶通知某批注射器筒的矽油（Silicone）分布不均，觸發了你的什麼程序？
blocks.en: A customer notifies you that the silicone oil distribution on a batch of syringe barrels is uneven. Which of your procedures does this trigger?

blocks.zh: 你的下游製藥廠要求你提供某批次的全部生產數據，哪些可以提供？哪些是機密知識產權？
blocks.en: Your downstream pharmaceutical customer asks you to provide all production data for a certain batch. Which data can you provide, and which is confidential intellectual property?

blocks.zh: 你的供應商要更換玻璃管供應商，這觸發了哪些 8.5.6 變更控制要求？
blocks.en: Your supplier wants to change the glass tubing supplier. Which 8.5.6 change control requirements does this trigger?
